shots.graphic: Dark room, camera tight on the flip clock; minute card flips 06 to 07; '3:07am.' rises under it
Camera pulls back to the moonlit bedroom; clock 3:12; duvet kicked off the bed edge; 'Duvet off.' lower third
Clock 3:19; duvet pulled back on; second word flips to 'on.'
Clock 3:41; pillow hops and flips to its cold side with sparkles
Clock 4:02; casement swings open, curtains billow, air streaks, a leaf lands on the bed
Clock spins to 7:15, sky turns dawn, room warms, camera tilts; glockenspiel on 'forgotten'
Scrim; 'Night sweats' big + Figtree line; Source: NHS; petals drift in the dawn light
Room blurs; phone rises with the real Log screen; 'Log it before you forget.'; tap on Night Sweats; calm hold
